We've done everything possible to make an amazing vintage pedal, even better. Dripping with fuzz, super dynamic, trim-pot adjustable bias, and more. I love this pedal and I think you will too. Don't like the low output on a traditional FF? Fixed it. All the volume you could ever want or need. Don't like the way that a traditional FF fuzz knob is only useful at the last end of the knob? We've added a reverse-log potentiometer that widens that range and let's you dial things in just right. Mullard “tropical fish” out-cap with increased value to allow more lows to come through. Also, Mullard tropical fish caps just look damn cool. Custom “You” knob functions as a low-cut to reduce some of the low-end squash, letting you dial things in just right for "you". This is a simple but fantastic mod that gives an incredible amount of versatility. I've seen this mod alone turn FF haters into instant fans. If you've poured over the masses of FF descriptions trying to decide what to get, you can't go wrong the the Your Face 60's. sources.excerpt: Your Face 60's by Wren and Cuff | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Wren and Cuff Your Face 60's LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description Germanium transistor lovers, rejoice! Wren and Cuff has done everything possible to make an amazing vintage pedal even better. Dripping with fuzz, super dynamic, trim-pot adjustable bias, and more. Many musicians love the classic round fuzz pedals for their sound, but most of them don't like the traditional low output. Wren and Cuff fixed that and the Your Face 60's Germanium Fuzz offers the unique vintage sound and in addition, all the volume you could ever want or need. Another problem with the vintage units is the way that the Fuzz knob is only useful at the last end of the knob, so Wren and Cuff added a reverse-log potentiometer that widens that range and let's you dial things in just right. They also used Mullard 'tropical fish' out-cap with increased value to allow more lows to come through. The adjustable Low-Cut control can be used to reduce some of the low-end squash, this is a simple but fantastic mod that gives an incredible amount of versatility. 0 Visit Shop Media Videos Wren and Cuff Your Face 60's - Demo Video - Ricardo Marins Oficial Wren and Cuff Your Face 60's - Demo Video 1/3 (feat.
